title: Risk Sources and Risk Management Measures in Support of Standards for General-Purpose AI Systems
findings: The paper identifies 'religious bias' as a type of systemic bias in AI systems, noting that debiasing methods can focus on stereotypes related to religious beliefs. This is presented as part of a broader catalog of risks rather than an empirical finding from a new experiment.
